description.text: The camera holds a static shot in a modest service area.

stands behind a wooden counter, a ledger open under his hand and a pen resting on the page. Warm overhead light falls across the countertop, picking out the grain of the wood, the pale edge of the paper, and a small brass bell near his wrist; the shelves and wall behind him sit in soft shadow. He is in medium close view, shoulders square to the counter, gaze angled down at the paperwork. At first he is writing, the pen moving in short strokes, then he stops. He sets the pen down with a small tap, lifts his head, and meets the person across from him. His expression stays level and unhurried. He speaks the fixed line evenly in a dry, close voice, holding eye contact through the final word. The camera remains still, letting the pause after the line sit in the quiet room tone, with only the faint settling of the building around them.
